text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To both of you. Thank you so very much for 
today. I had so much fun at the birthday 
tea party♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right! Even though I was the one giving 
it, I had a total blast myself! —And above 
all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The matcha Grass-chan made for me! It was 
delightfully bitter and so good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. I usually drink black tea, so this 
felt quite refreshing~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! It had this super refined 
bitterness to it! It really is nothing 
like chameleon plant tea, huh!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. Thank you very much. It makes 
putting my heart into whisking the tea so 
worthwhile...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew~. All this talking has made me crave 
a nice bowl of matcha~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Um. In that case... would it be all 
right if I invited you to a tea party 
again?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Matcha really is rather bitter, after 
all... So it is quite rare to find someone 
who can enjoy it with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, my! Are you truly certain~? Yippeee~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, yay! I'm super happy! ...Ah, but are 
you sure? Isn't making tea a lot of work?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"No! The joy far outweighs any hardship. 
It really makes you want to shout... 
'Yahoo~!'♪"
